description: Customer reviews of the app from the App Store and Google Play in one list, newest first: stars, title, text, the reviewer's name, the App Store country or the Google Play language, the app version (Google Play only), the date, and the developer's reply if there is one. Each store's ratings summary too (the App Store's own average and count; for Google Play, the average of the reviews read). Google Play gives only reviews with text from about the last week; older ones are only in Play Console. Filter by store, stars (a list such as [1, 2]) and unanswered.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

fresh.description: Ask the stores again instead of Ploa's last answer (a few minutes old at most).

name: ploa_reviews_get
title: Read customer reviews
